note: Field Missions: real-world tasks, debriefed with Poise afterwards. Never film other people; the debrief is spoken or typed by the user.

missions.title: One real question
missions.task: Ask a barista, cashier or doorman one real question that isn't about the transaction.

missions.title: Name, twice
missions.task: Learn someone's name today and use it once, naturally, later in the same conversation.

missions.title: The connector
missions.task: Introduce two people who haven't met, with one detail that gives them something to talk about.

missions.title: Twenty seconds
missions.task: At the next meal with three or more people, raise a glass and say something for twenty seconds.

missions.title: One clean no
missions.task: Decline one thing today with a single reason and no apology.

missions.title: Specific credit
missions.task: Give someone specific credit for something they did, in front of others.

missions.title: Let it sit
missions.task: In one conversation, let a pause sit for three seconds instead of filling it.

missions.title: Three beats, live
missions.task: Tell one story today in three beats: setup, turn, line. Then stop.

missions.title: Say the other view
missions.task: Disagree with someone once today, calmly, with one reason, and stay friendly.

missions.title: Bring them in
missions.task: Notice the quietest person in a group and ask them something real.
